name: The Old Circle: Ecos da Masmorra
description:
About This Game

The seal is breaking.


Beneath the village of Oldstone, the Order of the Seal once locked away the things the world wanted to forget. Now the seals are failing one by one, and something older than memory is waking up.

The Old Circle is a top-down action RPG with real-time combat and hand-tuned pixel art. Prepare in the village, descend into the dungeons and bring back what you need to forge your next build. Play alone or bring up to three friends.

Five classes, endless builds

Hold the line as a Warrior, strike from afar as a Ranger, freeze and shatter as an Arcanist, keep the party alive as a Priest or raise an army as a Necromancer.
  • About 15 skills per class in the Grimoire, each one upgraded with stars and changed by aspects
  • A talent tree for every class, up to level 60
  • 74 glyphs and 15 runes that rewrite how your skills behave
  • 50 gear sets crafted at the forge, each changing your hero's look

21 dungeons, 21 rules

Seven chapters take you from forgotten catacombs to a sun that never sets and a night without stars. Every dungeon bends the fight with its own rule: cold that freezes you solid, heat that ignites, light that burns, darkness that hunts, and memories that fade.

Bosses worth learning

21 bosses with multiple phases, unique mechanics and clearly telegraphed attacks. Read the pattern, dodge, break their defenses and punish the opening.

Better together

  • Online co-op for up to 4 players through Steam, or on your local network
  • Individual loot: nobody steals your drops
  • Revive fallen allies; encounters scale with the size of the party

It does not end at the final boss

  • The Infinite Archive: an endless mode that gets harder the deeper you go
  • Four difficulties, up to Torment
  • The Book of Trials: 104 challenges with titles to earn
  • Floor events: treasure thieves, cursed altars, shrines and chests that bite back

Features

  • Real-time action combat with dodging and telegraphed attacks
  • Classic pixel-art view or an optional 3D-lit mode with real-time lights and shadows
  • Full controller support
  • Available in English, Portuguese, Spanish, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Japanese and Korean
short_desc: A pixel-art action RPG for 1 to 4 players. Choose one of five classes, master real-time combat, shape your build with glyphs, runes and 50 gear sets, and descend through 21 dungeons with their own deadly rules to face 21 bosses, solo or in online co-op.
